acceptance: Codex tool_search requests, history, calls, and stream events round-trip across Responses and Chat without dropping IDs or client-execution semantics
Unsupported server-side tools remain explicit safe field/direction errors; future unsupported tools expose only a bounded type discriminator in logs

A local upstream fixture that emits a Responses output event and then resets yields a protocol-level terminal error event with monotonic sequence_number, a failed request log, the actual upstream/downstream statuses, and a bounded failure phase

No automatic retry is made after ambiguous request transmission or partial output; logs never retain prompts, bodies, schemas, tool arguments, or credentials
